## Summary

| TOR | Pages | Features (key) | Coverage recall (LLM judge) | Coverage recall (fuzzy/embedding) | Extra features not in key | Sizing exact | Sizing within one tier | Planted flaws caught | Runtime | Tokens | Est. LLM cost |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| tor_A_clean | 5 | 17 (16) | 100% | 100% | 0 | 14/16 (88%) | 16/16 (100%) | n/a | 43 s | 73,806 | $0.039 |
| tor_B_messy | 16 | 22 (18) | 100% | 78% | 3 | 8/18 (44%) | 18/18 (100%) | 7/7 | 78 s | 103,829 | $0.051 |

Matching: each answer-key feature is matched to an in-scope system feature by an LLM judge (gpt-4.1-mini, one call per TOR: same capability, possibly broader or differently worded; several key features may map to one system feature). The score column shows the embedding similarity for reference. Fallback if the judge fails: an answer-key feature counts as found when a system feature has embedding cosine ≥ 0.65 (≥ 0.6 when feature types agree; key name without parentheses vs system name, or vs system name + description) or rapidfuzz token-set ratio ≥ 75. Several key features may map to one broader system feature.

| Feature-set overlap, capability-matched (LLM judge) | 0.93 | 0.85 | ≥ 0.85 | PASS |
| Size agreement (matched features) | 83% | 76% | ≥ 85% | BELOW |
| Total hours, Traditional (pre-AI) | 3745, 4153, 4204 | ±7.2% | ±5% | BELOW |

| Total hours, AI-enabled, same deadline | 2853, 3164, 3203 | ±7.2% | ±5% | BELOW |
